text: The voice typing is excellent, and the transcription is really good, but I wish there were more features for editing the keyboard. I wish the keyboard had more options, like: 1. A full stop shortcut within the keyboard. 2. An option to have the keyboard show up as the default, with a little icon for voice transcription on the side. Features like this would make it so awesome, where you have the keyboard and the transcription both showing up in one.
